root.name: テンセント・ミュージック

relations.text: 支配株主。議決権の93.6%を保有し事業協力契約も結ぶ
relations.text_en: Controlling holder with 93.6% of votes; business cooperation pact

source.label: TME 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: As of March 31, 2026, Tencent beneficially owned 10.8% of our outstanding Class A ordinary shares and 98.5% of our outstanding Class B ordinary shares, and held in the aggregate 93.6% of our total voting power.

source.label: TME 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: • "Spotify" refers to Spotify Technology S.A., one of our principal shareholders;

companies.name: ユニバーサル・ミュージック・グループ

relations.text: テンセント主導の連合でUMG株10%を取得
relations.text_en: Joined the Tencent-led consortium buying 10% of UMG

source.label: TME 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: Transaction with UMG In March 2020, we joined a consortium led by Tencent to acquire a 10% equity stake in Universal Music Group, or UMG, from its parent company, Vivendi S.A.

relations.text: 傘下ソニー・ミュージックと楽曲ライセンス契約を更新

source.label: TME 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: For example, we renewed contracts with Sony Music Entertainment, Warner Music Group, and Bin-music in 2025 to enhance our timeless and classic music offerings.

companies.name: カカオエンターテインメント

relations.text: K-POPチャートの共同立ち上げで事業協力

source.label: TME 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: In December 2025, we signed business cooperation agreements with Kakao Entertainment, LINE MUSIC, and others to jointly launch the "K‐pop Artist Chart." The new chart, to be introduced on Melon, will reflect objectively user activity and platform data from participating music services and is scheduled to officially launch in the first half of 2026.
